statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // .model.id'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort_level // "standard"'); tokens=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tokens.current_turn // 0'); budget=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tokens.budget // "∞"'); timestamp=$(date '+%H:%M'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); base=$(basename "$dir"); branch=$(git --git-dir="$dir/.git" --work-tree="$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); session=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session.id' | cut -c1-8); printf '\033[1;36m%-12s\033[0m  \033[1;33m%s\033[0m  \033[1;35m%s\033[0m  \033[1;32m%dk/%s\033[0m  \033[2m%s\033[0m  \033[2m%s\033[0m' "$model" "$effort" "$timestamp" "$(($tokens / 1000))" "$budget" "$base" "$([ -n \"$branch\" ] && echo \"($branch)\" || echo \"(detached)\")"; [ -n "$session" ] && printf '  \033[2m[%s]\033[0m' "$session"
